normalization: cellwise human-library counts per 10000, including human PAR_Y in the denominator
target_feature_candidates: unique original human ENSG features excluding PAR_Y; no legacy-ID collapsing
feature_selection: top population variance of log1p normalized counts across source-line A-control cells only; pooled cells; deterministic source-feature-row tie break
control_partition: within each plate, lexical well-name order: first=A state input, second=B scoring reference
control_state: log1p of equally weighted A-well normalized means within each cell line; one vector per line
effect_definition: log2((equal-replicate mean treated normalized counts + 1)/(equal-replicate mean matched B-control normalized counts + 1))
main_cohort: same drug and dose present in all three lines and each atom has >=20 treated cells
sensitivity_cohort: main cohort restricted to drug-dose triples with both treatment measurements >=20 cells in all three lines; evaluation restriction, not a refit
control_swap_status: NOT_RUN; A and B well means retained for a separately versioned sensitivity
inference_scope: one study; three dependent LOCO folds; descriptive technical verification only
